recommendation: Collect exact prospective SOL Range Onset outcomes by clear versus opposed dual-MTF context without changing the canonical live route.
why_now: SOL was two-thirds ready and awaiting only its hourly cross while its tentative long structure opposed bearish 5m and 15m context. Prior report-only evidence found five opposed missing-cross longs and all five lost after modeled costs.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The v51 SOL route records a causal dual-MTF context challenger but does not use it as an entry gate. Sparse prior opposed paths were adverse, creating a route-specific hypothesis that has not been prospectively tested on canonical eligible entries.
applicable_market_regime: SOL hourly structural crosses observed during measured 5m and 15m directional context, separated into clear and opposed cohorts.
alternatives_considered: Apply the ETH dual-MTF gate to SOL immediately, rejected because the evidence is post-hoc and sparse.
Use universal regime confidence for leverage, rejected by unstable and autocorrelated regime calibration evidence.
Leave the context unmeasured, rejected because the required causal telemetry already exists at negligible research cost.
Keep the canonical SOL route unchanged while prospectively scoring context cohorts, selected.
expected_upside: Determines whether a route-specific context condition can reduce adverse SOL entries without sacrificing the sparse profitable canonical events.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: Sparse eligible events can produce false separation.
Repeated one-minute evaluations are autocorrelated and cannot be treated as independent trades.
Selecting a filter after seeing the five adverse paths creates post-hoc bias.
A context filter can remove the concentrated winners that drive historical SOL profitability.
validation_completed: The v51 provider emits causal dual-MTF clear/opposed telemetry without execution authority.
Five prior opposed missing-cross long paths were negative after modeled costs, with total -62.9077 bps and median -11.9296 bps.
Historical SOL Range Onset remained positive on accepted clean blocks, so the unchanged route is the required control.
validation_still_required: Collect canonical eligible SOL entries after the prospective cutoff with exact clear/opposed context at decision time.
Resolve complete lifecycles with fees, funding, slippage, stop behavior, and maximum-hold attribution.
Compare the predeclared context cohorts by side, chronological segment, largest-winner removal, and unchanged-route opportunity cost.
Keep repeated telemetry rows clustered into independent entry episodes.
success_metrics: Clear-context lifecycles outperform opposed lifecycles after exact costs without relying on the largest winner.
The challenger improves the unchanged-route net result and drawdown across independent chronological episodes.
Research/live completed-bar context labels reconcile row-for-row for every evaluated entry.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: Opposed entries equal or outperform clear entries after exact costs.
The challenger removes a disproportionate share of profitable canonical SOL events.
Context labels disagree between live telemetry and causal replay.
Results become non-positive after largest-winner removal or reasonable friction stress.

minimum_additional_evidence.to_update_diagnosis: At least one fully resolved prospective canonical SOL lifecycle in every observed context and side cohort; absence of a cohort remains an explicit coverage result.
minimum_additional_evidence.for_change_recommendation: A predeclared compatible window with independent entry episodes, exact execution costs, side-specific results, chronological stability, unchanged-route comparison, and largest-winner sensitivity.

decision: Activate the report-only context cohort; preserve the current SOL strategy, sizing, leverage, stop, hold, and execution behavior.
